name: Kensho
description: Kensho lets agents read S&P Global company financials, earnings call transcripts, and market data through the Kensho LLM-ready API. It needs an S&P Global or Kensho subscription, and each user signs in through the browser.

prompts.text: Show the revenue and operating margin of Microsoft for the last five years.
Summarize the latest earnings call of Nvidia.
Compare the net debt of the three largest US airlines.

apps.name: Kensho
apps.description: Company financials, transcripts, and market data, over Kensho's MCP server with browser sign-in.
